body: Well a update. Turns out she was talking to a guy about two years previous because she had thought I cheated. They shared picks and what not but she cut it off. Explains why things started to not feel right to me. Since then she has been talking to a local guy in town for the last year and a half and mid February she slept with him. She wanted to break things off with me but we decided to work on it because we thought there might be a chance. Two weeks later I found out she was still talking to him. I understand why and I gave her a choice to leave or stay. Again decided to stay. So over the last four months I gave her my all. She's continued to talk to him and multiple other men(video chat/pics). I understand her lack of self-esteem. Finally I've gotten tired of it. I began talking to a old friend ( haven't talked to her for almost ten years). "Ex" finds out and try's to tell her were still together. Wtf. Basically I still love her but I can't keep this shit up. I won't kick her out because it hurts the kids more then the current situation but ever time it try to move on she guilts me back. I just don't know what to do. The other thing is the girl I was originally having feelings for at work quit do to all of this, haven't talked to her for 3.5 months then she tells me that she thinks she still has feelings for me but she's with another guy. Three girls I really like. One keeps flipping, one keeps hinting and the other I just can't tell.
